title: Sort dates by their names
hook: Day-first names mix months when sorted alphabetically.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: Compare lexicographic ordering of two explicit date formats.

objective: Compare lexicographic ordering of two explicit date formats.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: Day-first names mix months when sorted alphabetically. Which format sorts these dates chronologically as text? Correct option: YYYY-MM-DD. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.

All times, sizes, deadlines and outcomes describe this exercise only; no empirical productivity or learning effect is inferred. claims.text: The year-month-day names put the largest time unit first. For these fixed-width dates, alphabetical and chronological order coincide.
